la:adj:perurbanus.html:
pĕr-urbānus, a, um, adj.,
very polite, pleasant, or witty.
Lit.: L. Torquatus elegans in dicendo, toto genere perurbanus,: C. Lucilius et doctus et perurbanus,.—
Transf., with a bad accessory signif., over-fine, over-polite: cum rusticis potius quam cum his perurbanis,. —Adv.: pĕrurbānē, very elegantly: respondere,
